description: Daily vessel transits through the Panama Canal chokepoint, counted by ship type (container, dry bulk, general cargo, Ro-Ro, tanker) with capacity, from IMF PortWatch (ArcGIS, AIS-derived). Covers transit counts only, not booking slots or draft restrictions; the latest date lags real time by several days. Choose this tool for: Daily vessel transits through the Panama Canal chokepoint. Close alternatives on this server: logistics_suez_canal_telemetry (Daily vessel transits through the Suez Canal, counted); logistics_dardanelles_bosphorus (Daily vessel transits through the Bosporus Strait). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
